title: Tracked hook files hold one form on every host
when: Someone renders the Yoke repository's own Claude or Cursor hook files (yoke agents render) on native Windows, or an installed project refreshes hooks on a different OS than wrote them.
need: Repository-rendered hook files are POSIX (/bin/sh) on every host (decision 15934); Claude Code runs them through Git Bash on Windows. Machine-local user hooks and installed projects use the native PowerShell form on Windows, and Codex keeps its separate commandWindows field. Install and refresh recognise a Yoke entry written in the other shell form by matcher, verb and config owner, and replace it in place instead of adding a duplicate.
surface: agents render drift check, machine hook setup and project install hook merge.
review: Source tests pin POSIX repository render under a simulated Windows host, native machine and installed-project rendering, and cross-form convergence.
